groups.title: 1. Platform, identity and sites
groups.intro: Version, users, roles, labels, sites, remote locations and (deprecated) backup modules.

groups.title: 3. Schema and templates
groups.intro: Schemas, schema templates, template clone and migrate, schema sites, and NDO templates.

groups.title: 4. VRF
groups.intro: Template and site-local VRFs, VRF contracts, rendezvous points, regions, CIDRs and hub networks.

groups.title: 5. Bridge domains
groups.intro: Template and site-local bridge domains, subnets, DHCP policy attachments and BD-to-L3Out associations.

groups.title: 6. ANP and EPG
groups.intro: Application Network Profiles, EPGs, annotations, contracts on EPGs, selectors, subnets, uSeg attributes, domains and static leaf or port bindings.

groups.title: 7. Contracts, filters and external EPGs
groups.intro: Filter entries, contract filters, external EPGs, contracts and selectors.

groups.title: 8. L3Out
groups.intro: Schema-template and site-local L3Outs, plus NDO L3Out templates, nodes, interfaces and routing policies.

groups.title: 9. Service graphs and devices
groups.intro: Service node types, service graphs, contract service-graph associations, service chaining and service device clusters.

groups.title: 10. Tenant policy templates
groups.intro: NDO tenant policies (and their deprecated MSO predecessors): DHCP, QoS, IPSLA, IGMP/MLD, route maps, match and set rules, NetFlow, SPAN and endpoint tags.

groups.title: 11. Fabric policy and resource templates
groups.intro: NDO fabric policies (VLAN pools, domains, interface, node and pod settings, PTP, MCP, NTP, QoS, MACsec, syncE, SPAN) and fabric resource interfaces (physical, PC, vPC, FEX).

groups.title: 12. Validate, deploy and utility
groups.intro: Schema validate, template deploy status, NDO template deploy, and mso_rest.

modules.name: mso_schema_validate
modules.short: Validate the schema before deploying it to site
modules.description: This module is used to verify if a schema can be deployed to site without any error. This module can only be used on versions of MSO that are 3.3 or greater. Starting with MSO 3.3, the schema modules in this collection will skip some validation checks to allow part of the schema to be updated more easily. This module will check those validation after all changes have been made.

modules.name: mso_schema_template_deploy_status
modules.short: Check query of objects before deployment to site
modules.description: Check query of objects in a template of a schema

modules.name: ndo_template_deploy
modules.short: Deploy templates to sites on Cisco Nexus Dashboard Orchestrator (NDO).
modules.description: Deploy templates to sites. Prior to deploy or redeploy a schema validation is executed. When schema validation fails, cisco.mso.ndo_template_deploy fails and deploy or redeploy will not be executed. Only supports NDO v3.7 and higher

modules.name: mso_rest
modules.short: Direct access to the Cisco MSO REST API
modules.description: Enables the management of the Cisco MSO fabric through direct access to the Cisco MSO REST API. This module is not idempotent and does not report changes.
